name: Manolescu's non-triangulable manifolds via Pin(2)-equivariant Floer theory
from: Seiberg-Witten Floer theory / equivariant stable homotopy
summary: Equivariant Seiberg-Witten Floer homology of homology 3-spheres, via Galewski-Stern reduction, showed that manifolds of every dimension at least five need not be triangulable.

name: Wu's method: mechanised geometry theorem proving
summary: Ritt's characteristic sets turn elementary geometry statements into algebraic elimination so that machines can prove them.

name: Monstrous moonshine
summary: Dimensions of representations of the Monster group match coefficients of the modular function j, and a proof requires a new algebraic structure from string theory.

name: Wilf-Zeilberger method: computer algebra certifies combinatorial identities
summary: Rational-function certificates let a computer prove hypergeometric summation identities automatically.

name: Perfectoid spaces and tilting
summary: Characteristic p and characteristic 0 p-adic fields are related by an equivalence of Galois groups extended to geometry, moving results from one side to the other.

name: Shannon capacity of graphs and the Lovasz theta function
summary: A coding-theory quantity for graphs is bounded by a semidefinite programme, giving the theta function and its exact polynomial-time computation for perfect graphs.

name: Spin glasses: the Parisi formula
summary: A replica-symmetry-breaking prediction for the free energy of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model is proved by interpolation arguments and ultrametricity.

name: Fundamental lemma
summary: Ngo proved the fundamental lemma by interpreting orbital integrals through the geometry of Hitchin fibration.

name: Canonical bases and character sheaves: geometry in representation theory
from: algebraic geometry and topology (intersection cohomology, perverse sheaves)
summary: Intersection cohomology and perverse sheaves give the Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials and canonical bases of quantum groups.
